independence: Personally viewed all 18 native panels with view_image at original resolution after complete source and metadata preread, before seeing any root visual interpretation. IOP group labels, descriptions and candidate identity were visible. No clinical annotations, reader/reviewer flags or gold accessed.

group_observations.observations: All three panels show both femoral condyles and tibial plateau across the knee width with femoral/tibial longitudinal axes. This is a tilted coronal view, including central and posterior levels; it is not a sagittal side profile. The sag name is misleading while official Coronal is supported.

Six anterior, central and posterior views show paired femoral condyles and tibial plateau across the joint width. Both rows agree across contrast; Cor descriptions and supplied Coronal fit the local anatomy.

Six panels show longitudinal knee side profiles with anterior patella, individual condylar silhouettes and posterior structures. Sag descriptions and supplied Sagittal agree with native local anatomy.
Three panels show transverse distal femoral sections with paired condyles, anterior patella and posterior muscle/vascular cross-sections. Tra description and supplied Axial are supported.

conclusion: All six official planes agree with observed local anatomy. S4 t2_tse_sag is a tilted coronal series with appropriately supplied Coronal routing. Retain every official plane and record the description inconsistency without changing source, geometry or cache.
current_pipeline_implication: The loader routes with official Anatomical_Plane and ignores SeriesDescription, so the naming inconsistency does not affect current categorical routing. Full-source checks and six exact cache reproductions passed separately.
limitations: Eighteen selected native panels were visually reviewed; all 113 files were decoded and geometrically checked, not diagnostically interpreted.
No clinical target, anatomical laterality or report linkage inference.
No general IOP-over-description rule is inferred for other studies.
